paragraphs.text: Torment has four bicolored theme decks . As the set is a black -heavy, fittingly, one of the colors of each of the four theme decks is black. Furthermore, it is noteworthy that two copies of each of the "tainted lands" cycle is included in each of the theme decks.
Grave Danger is a blue /black theme deck with a threshold/graveyard-as-a-resource theme.
The rares in this deck are Cephalid Vandal and False Memories .
Insanity is an aggro black/ green theme deck that features the flashback and madness mechanics.
The rares in this deck are Nantuko Blightcutter and Nantuko Cultivator .
Sacrilege is a white /black theme deck with a reanimation theme.
The rares in this deck are Angel of Retribution and Ichorid .
Waking Nightmares is a black/ red theme deck with disruption and Nightmare themes.
The rares in this deck are Chainer, Dementia Master and Petradon .
